item.title: Far-Right Politician Tries to Cancel SLIPKNOT and JUDAS PRIEST Shows in Italy
item.description: Alcide Mosso, a member of Italy’s far-right Lega Nord party, has launched an attack on the Ferrara Summer Festival, held throughout the summer in the city of Ferrara.

item.title: Judas Priest's Rob Halford: "Political Debates Are Harder Than Ever"
item.description: Rob Halford had plenty to say about today’s polarized political landscape during a recent chat with Los Angeles Times En Español. In typical Halford fashion, he dove headfirst into the fact that a large portion of the metal community leans conservative, and he can’t help but be bemused by it.

item.title: Metallica's Kirk Hammett Declares Judas Priest the True Founders of Heavy Metal
item.description: Kirk Hammett isn’t here to play revisionist history with metal. When the drummer Carmine Appice tossed out the claim that heavy metal only began with Metallica, some folks had a field day.
